note: Datasheet rules that allow a second Leader on one Bodyguard unit (Warhammer 40,000 app / datasheet text, Oct 2026). leaders: this Leader can join a unit that already has one other Leader matching 'with' (unit name or keyword; 'any' = any other Leader); nodup = not the same Leader twice. bodies: this unit can have up to n Leaders; max1 = at most one of them may have that keyword; ss = only at that Starting Strength (model count); nodup = no duplicate Leaders. Support units (MFM SUPPORT lists) are separate and unchanged.
